articles.title: France’s central banker Beau clashes with Lagarde over private digital euro plans
articles.snippet: France’s central bank deputy governor told CoinDesk public and private European entities need to get involved in digital asset development, diverging sharply from Christine Lagarde’s stance.

articles.title: CleanSpark shares slide after reporting $378M fiscal second quarter loss
articles.snippet: CleanSpark posted a $378.3 million net loss in its fiscal second-quarter results, more than double the prior year, with nearly 60% tied to Bitcoin price declines.

articles.title: ‘I failed them’: Goliath Ventures CEO charged with crypto Ponzi apologizes
articles.snippet: Christopher Delgado, the former Goliath Ventures CEO charged with fraud and money laundering, has publicly apologized to investors of what US prosecutors allege is a Ponzi scheme.

articles.title: EBay Rejects GameStop's $55 Billion Offer as 'Neither Credible Nor Attractive'
articles.snippet: Publicly traded online marketplace eBay slammed GameStop's unsolicited $55.5 billion acquisition offer as insufficient.

articles.title: Ripple Lands $200 Million Financing Facility to Expand Institutional Crypto Brokerage
articles.snippet: The XRP-linked Ripple secures financing from Neuberger Specialty Finance to fuel growth of its prime brokerage platform.
